requirements.title: Variables
requirements.text: In order to keep score of the apples, you need "Collected" and "Missed" variables. These variables should be set to 0 when starting the project to avoid confusion.

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: Set the initial placement so that the apples fall from the apple tree and are of the correct size.

requirements.title: Falling apples
requirements.text: We program the apples to fall down, and to make it more realistic, we make the apples rotate.

requirements.title: Counting missed apples
requirements.text: Within a "repeat forever" command, create a condition check for missing the basket.

requirements.title: Counting the apples that make it into the basket
requirements.text: Create a condition that checks if an apple makes it into the basket or not. The condition should always be checked.

media.title: Apple picking season
media.text: It's time to pick apples. They are already falling from the tree themselves. There's a basket under the apple tree and you can find out how many apples have fallen into the basket, and how many missed it. Let's program it.

media.title: Apple picking season
media.text: It's time to pick apples. They are already falling from the tree themselves. There's a basket under the apple tree and you can find out how many apples have fallen into the basket, and how many missed it. Let's program it.

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: When you click on the green flag, all the sprites take their starting positions.

requirements.title: Basket control
requirements.text: Program the basket so that it can be controlled from the keyboard.

requirements.title: Ball falling
requirements.text: Program the ball to always fall down

requirements.title: Moving the ball up the screen
requirements.text: After reaching the bottom edge, the ball disappears and reappears at a random point at the top. Program that.

requirements.title: Counting missed balls
requirements.text: Within a "repeat forever" command, create a condition check for the ball missing the basket.

requirements.title: Counting the balls that make it into the basket
requirements.text: Create a condition that checks if a ball makes it into the basket or not. The condition should always be checked.

requirements.title: *Bonus: winning and losing
requirements.text: Add a check and victory announcement.

requirements.title: *The ball moves in a random direction
requirements.text: The ball turns in a random direction and starts moving. If it reaches the right or left edge, it bounces off.

requirements.title: *Bonus: modify the game as you see fit

media.title: Catch the balls
media.text: Catch the ball 5 times. To do that, control the basket using the arrows on the keyboard.
